actions.reason: The K4_C0001-K4_C0004 boundary is the weakest-supported of the decision-relevant neighbors: the union eigengap is dominated by the single-cluster resolution (candidate_k=1, 0.492), which is merge-compatible, and the normalized-cut cost is the highest among the four pairs (0.550), reflecting greater cross-boundary connectivity. Native geometry is conflicting rather than coherent (CT slightly negative with 59.6% of patients closer to the competing label; RNA and WSI marginal; only WXS supportive), so boundary representation is not affirmatively established. Biologically the two sets are not clearly distinct units: K4_C0001 is PBRM1-enriched with modest VHL enrichment, while K4_C0004 is VHL-enriched with PBRM1 depletion and no driver signal surviving global correction, a pattern compatible with a single VHL/PBRM1-axis unit rather than two independent subtypes. The union is therefore more consistent with a single unit than with two retained sets.

actions.reason: The K4_C0002|K4_C0003 boundary is the closest in the partition (mean between-affinity 0.193) and its structural diagnostics are internally conflicting rather than affirmatively separating: independent two-way spectral ARI is 0.846 with within-side affinity 0.570 exceeding between-side 0.193, yet the normalized-cut cost is 0.532, indicating substantial cross-boundary connectivity, and the union eigengap is dominated by the single-cluster resolution (candidate_k=1, leading gap 0.487), which is merge-compatible and must not be read as preserving two units. Native geometry concordance for this pair is weak and partially conflicting (silhouettes 0.052-0.143, negative fractions 0.16-0.29; only CT modestly separates, RNA/WSI/WXS show little distinction), and it has the smallest coverage (n=51). Biologically the two sets are not clearly distinct units: K4_C0002 shows OXPHOS/metabolic up-regulation (NES +2.788) while K4_C0003 shows immune/interferon up-regulation (NES +2.816), and their WXS profiles are VHL/PBRM1-depleted versus BAP1-dominant respectively; these are differences in program emphasis rather than evidence of independent discovery-stage units, and biological differences do not mechanically prohibit merge. With a weak/conflicting boundary and a single-cluster-dominated union, the union is more consistent with a single unit. This revision is provisional and returns to normal review.
